newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto sets 1997 prices for transgenic cotton.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto sets 1997 prices for transgenic cotton.

text.p: Monsanto Co said it will price its new Roundup Ready cotton at $5 to $8 per acre.

The cotton feed, which is available for the first time ever, allows farmers to spray crops with herbicides, such as Monsanto's Roundup, that will kill damaging weeds without harming the cotton plant. Monsanto introduced Roundup Ready for soybeans in 1996.
Monsanto markets budworm and bollworm resistant BT (bacillus thuringiensis) under the trade name Bollgard.
The company said a limited supply of cotton varieties containing the Bollgard genes and Roundup Ready genes will also be available at $40 per acre.
